top.title: Securitisation notes: demat only, ₹1 crore floor at every transfer
top.so_what: From 1 April 2027 transfers of securitisation notes, including older notes, must be in demat and at least ₹1 crore (amortising notes excepted). Smaller holdings may become hard to sell.

top.title: ₹2 crore penalty on a health insurer for claim rejections and deductions
top.so_what: A ₹2 crore penalty on one insurer for untenable claim rejections, and study groups on standard rejection codes and live claim tracking due to report by 26 December.

top.title: Client onboarding simplified: KYC data centralised at the KRA
top.so_what: Onboarding forms and KRA interfaces must change by 24 December. Done well, it shortens onboarding for mutual fund and broking clients.

top.title: DPDP: Consent Manager registration opens
top.so_what: Data Fiduciary duties start 13 May 2027. Where processing relies on consent, groups sharing customer data across entities will need a consent record each entity can rely on.

top.title: Arbitrators must be independent: no unilateral panels
top.so_what: Lender-picked arbitrators across many disputes put awards at risk of being set aside. HFCs must report action taken to NHB.

top.title: Risk Based Capital to start from Ind AS accounts
top.so_what: Working groups are to make Ind AS accounts the base for insurer capital. No rule yet, but solvency and capital plans may shift once proposals land.
